name: desktop-statusline
description: Compact status band above the prompt in the Claude Desktop app's Code tab. By default one line: session cost, tokens processed, prompt-cache time left (from the 1h or 5m TTL) and cache hit rate, plus plan usage limit meters and running agents. Folder, branch, session age, prompt count, context meter, last turn and compactions can each be switched on. Toasts at 80% and 95% of a usage limit. Fork of centminmod/desktop-statusline.

cache_ttl.title: Prompt-cache TTL
cache_ttl.description: How long your main conversation's prompt cache lives: enter 1h or 5m (anything else counts as 1h). The band marks the cache cold after this much idle time. Claude Code's docs give 1h on a Claude subscription within plan usage, and 5m with an API key, a cloud provider, or usage credits. A promptCacheTtl setting overrides both.

show_location.title: Show folder
show_location.description: Folder name and number of changed files.

show_branch.title: Show git branch
show_branch.description: Branch, worktree marker and commits ahead/behind.

show_session_age.title: Show session age
show_session_age.description: How long ago the session started.

show_context.title: Show context meter
show_context.description: Context window meter (the app already shows one).

show_tokens.title: Show tokens
show_tokens.description: Tokens processed this session (input, cache reads and writes, output; subagents included), in k or M.

show_cache_hit.title: Show cache hit rate
show_cache_hit.description: Share of the last turn's input read from cache.

show_cache_remaining.title: Show cache time left
show_cache_remaining.description: Minutes until the prompt cache expires, or 'cache cold'.
